title: Fly between islands
caption: Simple Planes gives fuel-powered travel to distant islands, and basic planes enter the random pool at tier 3. Here one passes the cherry shrine landmark.

title: Your starting pad
caption: Each team starts on a bare 3x3 grass pad above the void with a sapling, a water bucket and a lava bucket. A cobblestone generator comes first.

title: A random drop every 30 seconds
caption: Every active player gets a random item every thirty seconds. The corner list shows recent pickups, and the HUD counts down to the next drop and the next shared tier.

title: Automate with Create
caption: Create is the automation route. On this base a water wheel turns shafts and gearboxes that drive a mechanical press and a millstone.

title: The neutral market
caption: The market island between the teams is a protected safe zone with a villager shop, a public kitchen, a workshop and a community chest.

title: Chance Cubes
caption: Chance Cubes keep their native rewards, like this flock of witches riding bats. The market sells cubes from the start, and they join random drops at tier 3.

title: Landmark islands
caption: Rarer landmark islands from Ember's Floating Islands, like this steampunk workshop, are bigger builds with their own loot and hazards.

title: Sky caches
caption: Chat announces a sealed sky cache on an island in the middle. After two minutes, the first team to open it claims the loot.
